Ethan Cole: I'll check the provisioning script now. Last bug we saw defaulted to 4 if seat_count missing. Pushed a fix to handle CSV notes.

Maya Singh: Good call. Ethan, can you post a sanitized payload snippet we can forward?
Ethan Cole: Example sanitized export:
```
{"event":"generation","user_id":"[MASKED]","input":"[REDACTED]","model":"redwood-preview-1","tokens":86,"ts":"2026-11-05T12:34:56Z"}
```
ops-bot: Reminder: Attach /pilot-survey to the enablement invite to capture post-session blockers and a quick usefulness score (1-5).
Maya Singh: Proposal: 60m white-glove session with 20m tailored prompts, 25m integration Q&A, 15m next steps. Also, run a 3Q micro-survey immediately after. If they flag an integration blocker, auto-open a CS ticket and mark pilot board with "renewal:amber".
Zara Khan: Morning sessions preferred. Can we do Mon 2026-11-09 09:00 PT? Also want a short checklist for admin setup before the call.
Ethan Cole: Confirmed seats fixed to 8 and admins added. I uploaded pre-setup checklist and prompt pack: https://redwood.app/drive/pilots/monarch/prep-v1
Maya Singh: Invite sent for Mon 2026-11-09 09:00 PT (60m). Included pre-read and the survey link. I'll capture a one-line "win" and thumbs during the call.
ops-bot: Thread archived to pilot-monarch after 48h inactivity.
